brief:
The United States has denied Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas an entry visa to attend the UN General Assembly in New York next week, Al-Monitor reported Wednesday. The decision blocks Abbas from traveling to the international body's headquarters.

A source familiar with the case confirmed the visa denial, preventing the Palestinian leader from participating in the annual gathering of world leaders.
dek: The Palestinian Authority on Thursday slammed a decision by the United States to refuse visas for its officials to attend the UN General Assembly in New York next week, a move which includes president Mahmoud Abbas according to a source familiar with the case.
title: US denies Abbas visa to attend UN General Assembly
